title: Trump is making it easier for fossil fuel companies to leak methane
summary: In its latest gift to oil and gas companies, the Trump administration is expected to announce plans today to weaken rules that guard against methane leaks. Methane is a smog-forming pollutant and a powerful greenhouse gas that's up to 80 times as potent as carbon dioxide on a 20-year horizon. It's the primary component of […]
llm_summary: The Trump administration is set to roll back key regulations that limit methane emissions from oil and gas operations, making it easier for companies to release the potent greenhouse gas. Methane, which contributes to smog and is up to 80 times more warming than CO₂ over a 20‑year period, will face fewer reporting and leak‑prevention requirements, potentially accelerating climate impacts.
